description: This file declares classes and functions for wrapping and managing Android media codecs in a GPU context, including CodecWrapper and CodecOutputBuffer, with focus on video decoding and surface management.

classes.name: CodecOutputBuffer
classes.description: Represents a media codec output buffer that can be released and optionally rendered to a surface, supporting thread-safe release.

classes.name: CodecWrapper
classes.description: Wraps a MediaCodecBridge to provide higher-level features for video decoding, including buffer management, surface setting, and state tracking.

methods.name: ReleaseToSurface
methods.description: Releases the buffer and renders it to the surface.

methods.name: set_render_cb
methods.description: Sets a callback to be called upon release to the surface.

methods.name: CreateForTesting
methods.description: Creates a CodecOutputBuffer instance for testing purposes.

methods.name: TakeCodecSurfacePair
methods.description: Discards all outstanding buffers and returns the current codec surface pair.

methods.name: IsFlushed
methods.description: Checks if the codec is in the flushed state.

methods.name: IsDraining
methods.description: Checks if an end-of-stream has been queued but not yet dequeued.

methods.name: IsDrained
methods.description: Checks if an end-of-stream has been dequeued but the codec hasn't been flushed.

methods.name: HasUnreleasedOutputBuffers
methods.description: Checks if there are output buffers not yet released.

methods.name: DiscardOutputBuffers
methods.description: Releases all dequeued output buffers without rendering.

methods.name: Flush
methods.description: Flushes the codec and discards all output buffers.

methods.name: SetSurface
methods.description: Sets the surface bundle for the codec.

methods.name: QueueInputBuffer
methods.description: Queues an input buffer for decoding.

methods.name: DequeueOutputBuffer
methods.description: Dequeues an output buffer, returning a CodecOutputBuffer.
